digest.component_or_area: Copilot agent skills lint and validation
propositions: Copilot CLI silently drops skills with invalid SKILL.md frontmatter, including rebar-implement (description 1327 chars), rebar-janitor (description 1068 chars), and rebar-debug (unquoted colon in YAML).
The Agent Skills spec enforces a 1024-character description cap and strict YAML frontmatter parsing, but provides no error feedback when skills fail to load.
Rewrite SKILL.md descriptions as YAML folded block scalars to neutralize colon/quote parse failures and trim over-capacity descriptions to 1024 characters.

Add a deterministic lint check (scripts/check_skill_frontmatter.py) that validates all SKILL.md frontmatters parse as valid YAML with description <= 1024 chars, name matches [a-z0-9]+ pattern, and is wired into make lint.
Unit tests (tests/unit/test_check_skill_frontmatter.py) verify the happy path (all four skills valid) and failure cases (over-cap, empty, unparseable YAML, bad name).
